description: Integrate authentication and data persistence into the UI. Add login/register modals, replace 'Admin dashboard' button with auth-protected access, implement complete checkout flow (order form → confirmation → order history), add 'My Orders' modal for users, add user profile management, implement admin CRUD for products/orders/customers. Depends on FEAT-001 (database.js), FEAT-002 (auth.js), and FEAT-003 (20-product catalog).
steps: 1. Modify c:\MIdtermProject\anihan_market\index.html: add <script type="module" src="database.js"></script> and <script type="module" src="auth.js"></script> before app.js script tag

2. Add Login/Register modal to index.html before closing :
WELCOME

Log in

3. Add Order Form modal to index.html:
CHECKOUT

Complete your order

Total₱0

4. Add Order Confirmation modal to index.html: ORDER CONFIRMED

Thank you for your order!

Your order has been received and will be processed shortly.

5. Add My Orders modal to index.html:
YOUR ORDERS

Order history

6. Add User Profile modal to index.html:
YOUR ACCOUNT

Profile

7. Add Admin Login modal to index.html:
ADMIN ACCESS

8. Add Product Form modal (for admin CRUD) to index.html:
PRODUCT

Add product
9. Modify c:\MIdtermProject\anihan_market\index.html topbar: replace .top-actions div content with: Supporting local farmers
12. Modify app.js: replace hardcoded products array with: let products = []; // Will be loaded from database

14. Add updateUIForAuth() function to app.js:
    - Checks auth.isAuthenticated()
    - If authenticated: shows user name, shows 'My Orders' button, shows 'Profile' button, shows 'Logout' button, hides 'Log in' button
    - If not authenticated: shows 'Log in' button, hides other buttons
    - If auth.isAdmin(): shows 'Admin dashboard' button

15. Wire up Login/Register modal in app.js:
    - #loginButton click → open #authDialog, show login form
    - #loginTab click → show login form, hide register form
    - #registerTab click → show register form, hide login form
    - #loginForm submit → preventDefault, get form data, call auth.loginUser(), if success: close modal, updateUIForAuth(), notify('Welcome back!'), else: notify(error message)
    - #registerForm submit → preventDefault, get form data, call auth.registerUser(), if success: auto-login, close modal, updateUIForAuth(), notify('Account created!'), else: notify(error message)

16. Wire up Admin Login in app.js:
    - Replace existing #adminSwitch click handler
    - If auth.isAdmin(): show admin view directly
    - Else: open #adminAuthDialog
    - #adminLoginForm submit → preventDefault, get form data, call auth.loginAdmin(), if success: close modal, show admin view, updateUIForAuth(), else: notify(error message)

17. Wire up Checkout flow in app.js:
    - Replace existing #checkoutButton click handler
    - Check auth.isAuthenticated(), if not: notify('Please log in to checkout'), open #authDialog, return
    - Close #cartDialog, open #checkoutDialog
    - Pre-fill address/phone from auth.getCurrentUser() if available
    - #checkoutForm submit → preventDefault, get form data, get cart items, calculate total, create order object {userId, userName, items, total, status: 'Pending', deliveryAddress, phone, paymentMethod, createdAt}, call db.addOrder(), show order confirmation modal with order id, clear cart, close checkout modal
    - Order confirmation: show order id, 'Continue shopping' button closes modal

18. Wire up My Orders in app.js:
    - Add 'My Orders' button to #userActions when authenticated
    - Click → open #ordersDialog
    - Render orders: call db.getOrders(), filter by current user's id, sort by createdAt desc, render as .order-card elements
    - Each order card shows: order id, date, items count, total, status badge

19. Wire up User Profile in app.js:
    - Add 'Profile' button to #userActions when authenticated
    - Click → open #profileDialog, pre-fill form with auth.getCurrentUser() data
    - #profileForm submit → preventDefault, get form data, update user in localStorage (find in anihan_users, merge changes), update session, notify('Profile updated'), close modal

20. Wire up Logout in app.js:
    - Add 'Logout' button to #userActions when authenticated
    - Click → auth.logout(), updateUIForAuth(), notify('Logged out'), if admin view visible: show buyer view

21. Wire up Admin Products CRUD in app.js:
    - Modify renderProductsTable() to use db.getProducts()
    - #addProductButton click → open #productDialog, clear form, set title 'Add product'
    - Add 'Edit' and 'Delete' buttons to each product row in admin table
    - Edit button click → open #productDialog, pre-fill form with product data, set title 'Edit product'
    - #productForm submit → preventDefault, get form data, if id exists: call db.updateProduct(), else: generate new id, call db.addProduct(), refresh products table, close modal, notify('Product saved')
    - Delete button click → confirm('Delete this product?'), if yes: call db.deleteProduct(id), refresh products table, notify('Product deleted')

22. Wire up Admin Orders view in app.js:
    - Modify renderOrdersTable() to use db.getOrders()
    - Add 'Update Status' dropdown per order row (Pending/Processing/Delivered)
    - Dropdown change → call db.updateOrderStatus(orderId, newStatus), refresh orders table, notify('Order status updated')

23. Wire up Admin Customers view in app.js:
    - Rename 'Farmers' tab to 'Customers' in admin HTML
    - Replace hardcoded farmer cards with dynamic customer list from db.getUsers()
    - Render as table: columns: Name, Email, Phone, Registered Date, Total Orders (count from db.getOrders() filtered by userId)

24. Wire up Admin Overview stats in app.js:
    - Calculate stats from db.getOrders(): total revenue (sum of all order totals), farmer earnings (90%), platform revenue (10%), order count
    - Update #grossSales, #farmerEarnings, #platformRevenue, #orderTotal with calculated values
    - Update recent orders table from db.getOrders().slice(-5).reverse()
25. Update all modal close buttons: ensure [data-close] attribute wiring works for all new modals
26. Ensure cart persistence: on page load, restore cart from localStorage if exists (key: 'anihan_cart')
27. Test all flows end-to-end
acceptance_criteria: Login modal opens with login/register tabs
User can register (data saved to localStorage anihan_users)
User can log in (session saved to localStorage anihan_session)
Logged-in user sees name, My Orders button, Profile button, Logout button in topbar
My Orders shows user's past orders from localStorage
Profile modal allows editing name/phone/address
Admin dashboard button shows admin login modal for non-admins
Admin can log in with admin@anihan.ph / anihan2024admin
Logged-in user can add products to cart, proceed to checkout
Checkout requires login (shows login modal if not authenticated)
Checkout form captures delivery address, phone, payment method
Order confirmation modal shows unique order id
Order saved to localStorage anihan_orders
Admin Products tab shows all 20 products with Edit/Delete buttons
Admin can add new product via product form modal
Admin can edit existing product (form pre-filled, saves changes)
Admin can delete product (with confirmation)
Admin Orders tab shows all orders with status dropdown
Admin can update order status (Pending/Processing/Delivered)
Admin Customers tab shows all registered users in a table
Admin Overview stats calculated from real order data
Logout clears session and returns to unauthenticated state
Session persists on page refresh
Cart persists on page refresh
